outcome: Fetal hyperthyroidism (tachycardia, goiter, exophthalmos, suspected craniosynostosis)
cohort: A 29-year-old pregnant woman with a history of Basedow-Graves' disease and her fetus/newborn daughter.
finding: This case report illustrates the prenatal diagnosis and management of fetal hyperthyroidism secondary to maternal Basedow-Graves' disease and elevated TRAbs, leading to a live birth with confirmed neonatal hyperthyroidism requiring treatment.
